notes.title: Important Update 3.2.1. The new Demo!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/750339132399737742/B841B5642A7F52220AC718E9625E9CE9A853CAFA/[/img]

Dear friends! The last couple of months I've been preparing for a new frontier in my game development. But this stage I will keep a secret for now, but it forced me to study more deeply work on optimization of games. In this regard, I have prepared a major update related to the optimization and stable operation of the game.

Since I initially optimized the performance of the game well, despite its rather high requirements at a small size, this is quite a normal load for the Unreal Engine 4, considering that I tried to use all the modern achievements in the field of graphics. The game was praised for good optimization, although there were claims that the Witcher 3 or GTA 5 work better. It has a simple explanation. I tried to use in game such receptions, which in games rarely use or not use at all, in particular I'm talking about mirrors. In" Never Again " mirrors are part of the gameplay, they are placed throughout the game and in some locations they are interactive, that is, they can be rotated, reflect rays of light or teleport. The mirror is probably the hardest thing that kills FPS in games, because it renders twice everything that happens on the stage, so it was necessary to sacrifice something else. 

As a result, for my weak computer (GT740, i5) I was able to get +(5-10) FPS at the maximum level of quality. Now for me there is a stable 30fps in the game. Along with the optimization I fixed a number of old minor bugs that slightly spoiled the impression of the game and I added a few new settings.
[olist]
[*] Each object in the game is assigned a draw distance. There wasn't this function before, because I thought that the engine does it automatically and it is not necessary in confined spaces.

[*] I redesigned the lighting in some locations, now the GPU load is less and looks better!

[*] I reworked some heavy materials. Moved simple looping animations such as swinging swings or fire glow into the material, thus the load from the CPU moved to the GPU.

[*] Added a few new settings: 
[list]
[*] Ambient Occlusion is a very heavy Post Process and if you disable It you will get several FPS.

[*] Depth Of Field is a blur effect, which is also very heavy, turning it off will raise FPS in cut scenes, in stare mode and when viewing the diary.

[*] Just by popular demand in the game added Invert Camera Y and X.
[/list]

[*] During the fall into the water from the bridge, Sasha tried to delete, on old AMD processors it led to a hang of the game for a few minutes. I could not catch this bug for a long time due to the fact that Intel coped with it. Corrected.

[*] The Fear of darkness remained even with the flashlight on, if you use the inhaler with the flashlight on. It was solved by switching off / on the flashlight. Not a fatal bug, but a nasty one. Corrected.
[/olist]
And many other small bugs that I have been quickly fixed and forgotten)

Another important thing. Finally I updated the demo. Now after its completion you can continue from the place of the last save after buying the full version of the game. Those who are just planning to purchase and played the demo version of the game can clearly assess the evolution of graphics in the game.

At the moment, there is still a lot of work on optimization and stability. There will be a number of updates in this direction. For those who have not yet purchased "Never Again", you can now go through the demo version of the game for free and join us!

[b]Have a good game![/b]

notes.title: Traditional summer sale 2019! Update 3.1.5
notes.notes:
[IMG]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/771720478339458299/BEC90D224562D588F8E6AB9C83DF96861F276CC8/[/IMG]

Steam's annual summer sale has begun! You can purchase the game at a [b]25% discount[/b]. This is a very important event for us because we were forced to get out of early access to the release without a discount, for a small no name game this is a big obstacle. Today is almost the second release or even the third if we take into account the release in early access:)

Also yesterday I rolled out the update to 3.1.5
[olist]
[*]I rewrote the logic of the physical parts of the dolls in the cave, because of each collision played a lot of logical operations in this place strongly sagged fps. Optimized.
[*]Sometimes the damaged wire would hit the electricity even when the power was off. This problem could only be solved by rebooting the level. I never found a reason, so I rewrote the logic. I also added a check - if the sparks are off, the electric shock doesn’t work. Corrected.
[*]The default values in the " Smooth Camera” and “Fabric Simulation” settings are reversed. I noticed that some players complain that the camera motion makes them sick, it happened because I initially put a smooth camera. I do not know why I did it, I like the smooth movements of the camera. However, not all players knew about this setting. Sasha's dress simulation is now enabled by default. Initially, I turned off the fabric physics for optimization, but noticed that many players with powerful computers do not include this setting. I was upset by the fact that I tried to make it beautiful, but no one saw it:)
[*][SPOILER]If you do not use the inhaler after a meeting with the tank and enter the location with mirrors, it gave rise to a large number of bugs. This problem could be found through experiments. A reasonable solution I found only one thing - disable asthma when entering the location with mirrors.[/SPOILER]
[/olist]
Thank you for actively finding bugs and participate in the life of the game. Thanks for the good reviews! When a story becomes History.

notes.title: First fixes after release! 3.1.2
notes.notes:
I noticed that some players do not understand whether the game is released or not. Officially came out! The game can be played!

We found a few bugs, there are small - visual, and hard bugs - make the game impassable.
[olist]
[*]Statistics. There was a serious bug that did not delete the statistics if you start a new game after the full passage. Because of this it was possible to get some achievements without passing the game. Now it's fixed, the loophole is closed!)

[*]I fixed some issues with the game menu that had to restart the game.

[*]I also fixed a very serious bug that had to start the game again. If the player standing in the bath pressed the mirror with a painted stairs, then after the cut scene the player was thrown back into the bath. I hope you won’t find such serious bugs anymore.

[*]After the death of the bosses there were a subtitle with their last sentence sometimes. Fixed.

[*]If you die of asthma near the Doll Golem before his first meeting, the game moved the player to another location. You had to restart the game. Fixed.

[*]In a let’s play video I saw a player accidentally flew out of the lighthouse. I didn’t understand why this happened, but just in case the teleportation point put away from the window).
[/olist]
I’ve fixed other minor bugs that you found and helped make the game better. Thank you all, see you!

notes.title: About Devs, Release Date And Announcement Trailer!
notes.notes:
[IMG]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/985632993365805682/854D4ACBF06601E63A4DBCF8914F6C0AD9A7B1AF/[/IMG]

Hello dears! It's time to tell you about who we are and why we create the game for so many years. 

We are a young couple from Russia. We have been together for 7 years and 4 years we create a computer game [b]«Never Again»[/b]. This is our first project and, to be honest, it is difficult to imagine our life without it. First of all, the game is based on the story, emotional experiences and then the game component.

My name is Inna, I write the script, also adapt the game for the English-speaking audience and I am the voice of the main character. Valentine makes the game itself, the characters, he creates a virtual world for our story. And also writes an amazing music that you can check during the game.

Because it's more than just a game to us, we strive to make it as good as possible. But due to the fact that there are only two of us in the team, the development takes a lot of time. But nevertheless, our goal is to convey the meaning of the story and emotions to the player exactly as we see it.
For all these four years we had to tell dozens of times about the game to different people, to answer the same question: "so what is your game about?" And every time we go away from the answer, because we can’t tell what our story is about, because it will be a huge spoiler and a mistake on our part. 

The ending is the heart of our game. But we will make you happy! Very soon there will be a release of the full game and you can immerse yourself in the story of our Sasha Anders. You will be able to pass through all her fears, go through all the difficulties she had to face.
We hope that this game will leave a mark in your memory, after you pass it to the end. We want you to read it as a book, and the gameplay only helped to dive into the story.

Finally, we have chosen the final release date. [b]The game will be released on may 9[/b]. It doesn’t always go as planned, especially in indie development. Due to the fact that we did not have time to make a release in March, we are launching another 50% discount.

If you want to support us and buy the game at the time of release, then add the game to the wish list. It was a long journey. There is very little left, the finish line. Below you will find a new trailer for the game Never Again. Thank you for being with us!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yzg1wTkf_0U

notes.title: Version 2.4.1 Long-awaited Update
notes.notes:
[IMG]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/921434183975757415/15C30CD80A7C6ED9F29A2A83BC0ED4AA931538F1/[/IMG]

Hi friends! It has not been updates. I thought the latest version was enough for now, quietly doing the final Chapter, but the summer sale gave the heat.

Because of the high interest in the game there were many players who weren't very loyal to the small bugs and increased complexity. It turned out that a lot of players can't find an inhaler at the beginning of the game. They thought the game was broken and left a negative feedback. This greatly lowered the rating of the game and we had to stop and redo some points:

1) We have redesigned the hint system. Training has become more detailed. I hope this will eliminate ambiguous moments in the game and simplify the passage. This is not one reason why we started to move towards simplifying the gameplay.

For us the most important thing is the disclosure of our story but impassable places prevent immersion in it. [b]Now only English and Russian are temporarily available in the game.[/b]

[IMG]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/921434183975751486/26B4C46E69FE196E6BBA385849878ED7BDCD6B5C/[/IMG]

2) The Doll Golem was also simplified. We've added camera shake and boost sound when it's approaching the player. With other bosses we've done the same.

3) We removed invisible capsules that prevented running away at the end of the second Chapter. Who couldn't pass understand what it is. We removed any obstacles in this place.

4) The mirrors incorrectly unwrapped Sasha after teleportation. This greatly complicated the game. When I change one thing another thing breaks. I noticed it too late... Now it's fixed, sorry.

5) When Sasha died for the first time from suffocation in a lighthouse the script "Knock at the door" was started and Sasha said "Who is here?" but the player didn't hear it because it was already far from his room. Fixed.

6) Sometimes the door in the lighthouse didn't open. I couldn't reproduce this bug. I died for 50 times but the door still opened. Suggested what it could be. Corrected. But not sure...

7) The daylight in the lighthouse wasn't set correctly. Fixed.

8) I added some billboards with titles of the chapters to make it clear where the previous Chapter ends and the next one begins.

[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/921434183975762453/6A198DCA759F5BA5A645058F45EE2A3328B39F39/[/img]

And some more visual changes such as keyholes and some small bugs. I think there will be a few more updates before the final Chapter. Thank you for staying with us no matter what!

[b]When a story becomes History. Never Again.[/b]

notes.title: Version 2.3 Update
notes.notes:
[IMG]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2418873130669534041/818008BAE042DEE62F0150561BE0BC2B45121350/[/IMG]

Yay! Finally we made a big update of two chapters. It wasn't too easy. We've faced with some difficulties that I described in previous announcements. This update is not so perfect. You can see new bugs due to the transition to a new version of the engine but we tried to check and fix as much as possible. 

Please let us know about any bugs that you encounter: game bugs, translation mistakes etc. We read every comment and pay our attention to it. 

Update list:
[olist]
[*]Diary improvements. Tips and controls made it more friendly.

[*]Cut scene animations have been redone. They are not perfect yet: lack of smoothness and sounds, but definitely more cinematic.

[IMG]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2418873130669563671/3C63ABAF5475E0E4E468AFF854D829C3C22215B4/[/IMG]

[*]We have added the ability to change the controls of some keys. Who did not like the standard keyboard layout you can change it for yourself. This function will be further developed.

[IMG]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2418873130669556118/ABF6ED75A5B5AFCA774F3A96D08E96D53B92E8FF/[/IMG]

[*]We have completely redesigned the localization system. We have added Chinese and French!
The Chinese language has been prepared by Source Chinesizing Translation team: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/sourcect 

[IMG]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2418873130669558715/9F2B43248E3CECD11ED149E6F7B13B318923E3FA/[/IMG]

[*]We've added a hint highlight. Now the "Zoom" mode in the game is not just for beauty but opens for you previously invisible details in the game that will help you find secret places.

[IMG]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2418873130669561597/62650E69A4658F8E2DE402FE393DD266573EF1E2/[/IMG]

[*]We have reworked some shaders, such as stone walls in the cave, Sasha's hair and so on.

[*]We have also done a lot of work on optimization. Now the game loads quickly and the FPS level is increased by recycling the light and overall visuals.

[*]Finally we added grass on the street. A trifle, but nice and more cinematic.

[*]New 3840x1080 resolution and FOV setting. This is for owners of modern curved widescreen monitors.

[*]Finally, I found a terrible bug associated with the friezes of the Doll Golem. He was stuck because if the player threw the doll into the wall, the goal was not in the area of his movement and he could not achieve it, so he began buggy... We had to temporarily remove the mechanics of Golem distraction and remove the achievement of "To throw dust in the eyes" because of its unattainability.
[/olist]

These are just the main updates. We fixed a huge number of small bugs and added some content. This is not the end result there will be more updates for the first two chapters.

Without you guys the game would not exist. Thank you for staying with us.

When a story becomes History. Never Again.

notes.title: Second Chapter Update!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/903401556512084742/6B59DBA61CEFC0721687DC572A2B68028E282F2E/[/IMG]

Finally, the beta version of Never Again second chapter comes. In this chapter you can continue the breathtaking adventure of Sasha Anders. You can plunge again into this mysterious atmosphere and get the first key to unraveling the story.

[b]README! If you want to continue the game from your last save, you must transfer all the files from the folder: 
C:\Users\YOUR_USER_NAME\AppData\Local\NeverAgainAlpha_1-3\Saved\SaveGames

notes.title: Version 1.7 Update. I've fixed a hard bug.
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.gyazo.com/8e602caa27dac1aec541ea0e6329a850.gif[/img]
[olist]
[*]While I was creating the second Chapter, I found a bug in first Chapter, where some players couldn’t enter the cave. Player could get stuck in the beginning of a game and he didn’t get a chance to pass it. This error happens if you take the first note and after that you take the diary. Well, players intuitively take diary firstly and then notes. Bug fixed!

[*]Finally, I reduced the loading time. On my old computer the game loads 20 seconds faster. Let me know if the game loads faster on your computer.

[*]I redid some materials, because of this the FPS should be increased. If the optimization is better now on your computer, let us know, please!

[img]https://i.gyazo.com/2b105cd67001dfe3a4218c5bdf782866.gif[/img]

Many players are upset due to the fact that they can not understand the box code puzzle, but some people quickly understand what number is encoded in the tip. And we thought...do we need to simplify the code or to leave as it is. Is this puzzle too complicated? We want everyone to be comfortable to play. Please write in the comments if you had any troubles with this part.

notes.title: Version 1.6 Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.gyazo.com/436416fe281b9c2a508f522d77fca69a.gif[/img]

[olist]
    [*]I've fixed a bug with running at the time of asthma attack. When Sasha had an asthma attack while she's running, she kept running, despite the fact that she is lame. You couldn't turn run off. Now it's ok.

    [*]Now if you press the run button for running (sprint) during mini cut -scene, you don't need to press it after cut scene again, it stays pressed. I hope I wrote it correctly and understandable. ːsteamhappyː

    [*]Also I've done a nice fade at the time when you go to the main menu.

    [*]Ah Yes, the diary is closed by ESC now.

If something goes wrong, let me know, please! Thank you for join us!
